name: Differential / Transfer Case Fluid
summary: Rear differential (applies to RWD and xDrive): single combined fill/drain plug (14 mm hex, M22x1.5), no separate drain on E90 per two E90-referencing sources plus an X5 thread; fluid is BMW SAF-XO 75W-90 GL-5 for an open differential (part 07512293972, confirmed by Turner, ECS and FCP Euro; Turner lists E90 328i/328xi); fill-hole-first rule and fill-until-it-trickles method are corroborated; torque 60 Nm (44 ft-lb) corroborated by two E90-referencing sources without O-ring (65 Nm with O-ring is single-source from an E60 thread). Capacity CONFLICTS (1.0 L vs 1.2 L). xDrive-only items: transfer case fluid DTF-1 (83225A4F016 / 83220397244) is supported by BimmerWorld and FCP Euro SKU text, about 1 L (single source); front differential capacity, plug location, torque, and transfer case torque and plug positions are MISSING. Rear-diff content can ship now; xDrive content is BLOCKED until drive type is confirmed and sources are found. No source distinguished open vs LSD on a 328i; FCP says LSD needs 75W-140.
variantDependencies: RWD: rear differential only. xDrive (328xi): rear differential plus front differential plus ATC transfer case; drive type UNCONFIRMED for this VIN.
Open vs limited-slip rear differential: open uses 75W-90 (SAF-XO, 07512293972); LSD per FCP blog needs 75W-140 (BMW 83222282583, 5 L). 328i diff type UNCONFIRMED.
Rear diff code (E60 thread mentions 188L/188LW; E90 code not sourced): capacity may vary by diff size; one source says 1.2 L is for the 335i only.
Automatic vs manual transmission: no effect on diff/transfer case fluid found; transmission fluid is out of scope.
Early BMW rear differentials may have separate drain/fill plugs (E60 thread); E90 sources describe a single plug.

steps.title: Confirm configuration
steps.instruction: Identify drive type (RWD vs xDrive) and rear diff type (open vs LSD) from build options before buying fluid. Do not assume.
steps.status: MISSING (no source for decoding this VIN)

steps.title: Warm the fluid and level the car
steps.instruction: Drive 5-10 minutes so the oil flows, then park on level ground; a posted tip is to warm the new oil in a bowl of warm water.

steps.title: Loosen the fill plug first
steps.instruction: Break the 14 mm hex plug loose before removing anything else, so you know you can refill. On the E90 rear diff this is the only plug and it also serves as drain.
warnings: Never drain until you are sure the fill plug will open.

steps.title: Extract old fluid
steps.instruction: Pump the old oil out through the fill hole with a suction pump and tube; measure the volume (reports of 0.95 L extracted).
warnings: Some oil may remain; one poster did a second drain-and-refill after a week.

steps.title: Refill
steps.instruction: Pump new SAF-XO 75W-90 in through the fill hole until it begins to trickle from the opening (the fill level is the bottom of the hole).

steps.title: Refit plug and torque
steps.instruction: Clean, fit plug (new O-ring if used) and tighten to 60 Nm (44 ft-lb) for no O-ring.

steps.title: Test
steps.instruction: Test drive and check for leaks or noise.

steps.title: xDrive only: transfer case
steps.instruction: Open the fill plug first, drain via the drain plug, refill with about 1 L DTF-1 through the fill plug until overflow. Plug sizes: 14 mm hex (X5 E70 poster).
warnings: Applies only if the car is xDrive; torque MISSING.

steps.title: xDrive only: front differential
steps.instruction: Fluid is reported as 75W-90, but plug location, procedure, capacity and torque were NOT found.

safety: Always confirm the fill plug can be removed before draining.
Support the car on stands or a lift on level ground (general practice).
Gear oil and old fluid are hazardous; contain and dispose of properly.
Wrong fluid in an LSD or transfer case can cause damage; bavmods warns against non-approved fluid.
Avoid over-tightening aluminum housing plugs; use a torque wrench.
